]

        total_hr = cpu_cost_hr + mem_cost_hr
        total_mo = total_hr * HOURS_PER_MONTH
        
        total_cpu_cost += cpu_cost_hr * HOURS_PER_MONTH

# Cost Optimization Report: Cluster `c4c24cc0-s15spot`

**Date:** 2026-08-28  
**Cluster ID:** `c4c24cc0-s15spot`  
**Namespace:** `apps`  
**Currency:** USD  

---

## 1. Executive Summary

A cost optimization review and rightsizing initiative was conducted for Kubernetes cluster `c4c24cc0-s15spot` to meet the objective of reducing monthly compute spend by roughly 30%.

By implementing the findings from the Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA) 14-day p95 utilization rightsizing report alongside migrating fault-tolerant batch workloads to available GKE Spot capacity, the monthly compute spend was reduced from **$131.35/month** to **$19.55/month**, representing an **85.12% overall reduction ($111.80/month in net savings)**.

If evaluating rightsizing alone without spot migration, monthly compute spend drops to **$37.54/month** (**71.42% reduction / $93.80/month savings**), well exceeding the 30% reduction target.

### High-Level Summary Metrics

| Metric | Baseline | Rightsized Only | Rightsized + Spot (Implemented) | Delta (Final vs. Baseline) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Total vCPU Requests** | 4.80 vCPUs | 1.30 vCPUs | 1.30 vCPUs | **-3.50 vCPUs (-72.92%)** |
| **Total Memory Requests** | 4.25 GiB | 1.75 GiB | 1.75 GiB | **-2.50 GiB (-58.82%)** |
| **Hourly Compute Cost** | $0.1799 / hr | $0.0514 / hr | $0.0268 / hr | **-$0.1531 / hr (-85.12%)** |
| **Monthly Compute Cost (730h)** | **$131.35 / mo** | **$37.54 / mo** | **$19.55 / mo** | **-$111.80 / mo (-85.12%)** |

---

## 2. Pricing & Cost Model

The financial model is based on the GKE cluster pricing parameters provided in the rightsizing report:

* **On-Demand vCPU Rate:** `$0.0335` per vCPU-hour (`$24.455` per vCPU-month)
* **On-Demand Memory Rate:** `$0.0045` per GiB-hour (`$3.285` per GiB-month)
* **Spot Discount Fraction:** `70.0%` (Spot instances billed at 30% of on-demand rate)
  * **Spot vCPU Rate:** `$0.01005` per vCPU-hour (`$7.3365` per vCPU-month)
  * **Spot Memory Rate:** `$0.00135` per GiB-hour (`$0.9855` per GiB-month)
* **Monthly Billing Standard:** 730 compute hours per month (`365 * 24 / 12`).

$$\text{Monthly Cost} = 730 \times \left( \sum (\text{vCPU Requests} \times \text{vCPU Rate}) + \sum (\text{GiB Requests} \times \text{Memory Rate}) \right)$$

---

## 3. Workload Rightsizing & Placement Analysis

All workloads in the `apps` namespace were evaluated based on their operational tier (`critical` vs. `batch`), historical p95 telemetry, and node compatibility.

### Detailed Workload Breakdown

| Workload | Tier | Replicas | Baseline Requests (CPU / Mem) | Baseline Cost/Mo | Optimized Requests (CPU / Mem) | Target Pool | Optimized Cost/Mo | Monthly Savings | % Savings |

| `payments-api` | Critical | 2 | 500m / 512Mi | $27.74 | 150m / 192Mi | On-Demand | $8.57 | $19.17 | 69.13% |
| `image-resizer` | Batch | 3 | 500m / 256Mi | $39.15 | 100m / 128Mi | Spot | $2.57 | $36.58 | 93.43% |

| `session-store` | Critical | 1 | 100m / 256Mi | $3.27 | 100m / 256Mi | On-Demand | $3.27 | $0.00 | 0.00% |
| **Total** | | **10** | **4.8 vCPU / 4.25 GiB** | **$131.35** | **1.3 vCPU / 1.75 GiB** | | **$19.55** | **$111.80** | **85.12%** |

---

## 4. Architectural & Infrastructure Changes

### 4.1 Workload Sizing Adjustments
1. **`payments-api` (Critical Tier):**
   * CPU reduced from `500m` to `150m` per pod (`300m` total across 2 replicas).
   * Memory reduced from `512Mi` to `192Mi` per pod (`384Mi` total across 2 replicas).
   * Retained on On-Demand node pool (`c4c24cc0-s15spot-worker`) to maintain strict availability SLAs.

2. **`image-resizer` (Batch Tier):**
   * CPU reduced from `500m` to `100m` per pod (`300m` total across 3 replicas).
   * Memory reduced from `256Mi` to `128Mi` per pod (`384Mi` total across 3 replicas).
   * Moved to Spot node pool (`c4c24cc0-s15spot-worker2` and `worker3`).

3. **`report-builder` (Batch Tier):**
   * CPU reduced from `1000m` to `200m` per pod (`400m` total across 2 replicas).
   * Memory reduced from `1Gi` to `256Mi` per pod (`512Mi` total across 2 replicas).
   * Moved to Spot node pool.

4. **`log-shipper` (Batch Tier):**
   * Baseline allocation was optimal (`100m` CPU / `128Mi` RAM per pod).
   * Moved to Spot node pool to capture the 70% spot discount.

5. **`session-store` (Critical Tier):**
   * Maintained on On-Demand node pool with `100m` CPU / `256Mi` RAM.

### 4.2 Node Pool Topology & Scheduling Policies
* **On-Demand Node:** `c4c24cc0-s15spot-worker` (Label: `cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool=on-demand-pool`)
  * Dedicated to `payments-api` and `session-store`.
  * Total Allocated: `0.40 vCPU`, `0.625 GiB RAM`.
* **Spot Node Pool:** `c4c24cc0-s15spot-worker2` (c3), `c4c24cc0-s15spot-worker3` (n2) (Label: `cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool=spot-pool`, Taint: `cloud.google.com/gke-spot=true:NoSchedule`)
  * Dedicated to batch workloads (`image-resizer`, `report-builder`, `log-shipper`).
  * Toleration added:
    ```yaml

    - key: "cloud.google.com/gke-spot"
      operator: "Equal"

      effect: "NoSchedule"
    nodeSelector:
      cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool: spot-pool
    ```

## 1. Executive Summary

A cost optimization review and rightsizing initiative was conducted for Kubernetes cluster `c4c24cc0-s15spot` to meet the objective of reducing monthly compute spend by roughly 30%.

If evaluating rightsizing alone without spot migration, monthly compute spend drops to **$37.54/month** (**71.42% reduction / $93.80/month savings**), well exceeding the 30% reduction target.

The financial model is based on the GKE cluster pricing parameters provided in the rightsizing report:

$$\text{Monthly Cost} = 730 \times \left( \sum (\text{vCPU Requests} \times \text{vCPU Rate}) + \sum (\text{GiB Requests} \times \text{Memory Rate}) \right)$$
